NAM.note: Nothing on AI rules or an authority.
The AI tool is for general public-service induction, not a sector system.
Says the guide was developed locally on open source and uses generative AI, but not that an AI model was built.
The modules teach how the public service works, not digital skills.
Built by UNDP-led staff, not stated to be government technical staff.

facts.fact: UNDP Namibia says the Office of the Prime Minister and UNDP launched the Being a Public Servant Digital Pocket Guide 2.0 on 24 November 2023, using generative AI with its own Pocket Bot for public servants.
